title: WaterColor "Family Matters" 313 East Royal Fern Way
h1: WaterColor "Family Matters" 313 East Royal Fern Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:-Per Watercolor Community guidelines the maximum number of wristbands this home is allotted is 14 bands to access Watercolor amenities and community pool- Private heated pool and sitting spa. **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $45 per day** The pool and spa are heated together.- Professionally decorated- 6- Passenger LSV Low Speed Vehicle- Ping pong table- Carriage house - 3 dedicated parking spots with additional parking throughout community- 6 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout**Unfortunately, the jets are not for guest use.Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Enjoy quintessential beach fun and quality time with loved ones at Family Matters, a 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom WaterColor property that sleeps 14 between the Main and Carriage House. With a private pool, sitting spa, and the community’s resort-style amenities, including multiple pools, a lazy river, and the WaterColor Beach Club, this home’s low-speed vehicle makes it easy to get around. It’s the perfect 30A getaway! Brimming with coastal charm, a beautiful front porch with soft seating leads the way into the 2-story Main House. Shiplap walls and plentiful natural light accent the professionally decorated interior. Relax after adventures in the sun on the living space’s plush furnishings to watch TV. Behind the couch, the wooden dining table seats 8 for delicious meals, homemade in the gourmet kitchen, which features high-end appliances, an open layout for easy conversing, and an island that doubles as a 4-stool breakfast bar. Continue out the back door, where a second porch offers the perfect setting for dining alfresco in the Gulf breeze. Take the steps down to access the brick-paved pool deck and unwind in the sitting spa, swim in the shimmering pool, or savor the fresh air from the comfort of the surrounding seating. An outdoor shower and dedicated bathroom helps keep dripping swimsuits and wet beach gear outside of the house. As the evening winds down, guests can rest comfortably in the guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom. The dedicated laundry room adds convenience for extended stays. Restless teenagers and other guests will enjoy the garage’s ping-pong table. Upstairs, discover additional sleeping accommodations—each featuring a private bathroom. The lovely primary bedroom and first guest bedroom each boast a king bed, while the second guest bedroom is a great option for families with a king bed and a twin-over-twin bunk. Guests who appreciate privacy will love the cozy Carriage House, which offers a living space with a sleeper sofa, kitchen, and a guest bedroom with a queen bed and a bunk bed.With delightful amenities and a WaterColor location, Family Matters offers an exceptional getaway for making the most of time together! Easily explore with parking for 3 vehicles—plus a large 6-seater low-speed vehicle and 6 complimentary bikes to carry beach coolers.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 14):FIRST FLOOR: -Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR: -Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower And Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo -Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo CARRIAGE HOUSE: -Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Twin-over-Twin Bunk, Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo *Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
